title: HandlerRuntimeAdapter
responsibility: Runs a unit in the calling isolate by invoking a handler function under the runtime contract.

inputs.name: HandlerRuntimeAdapter.constructor.handler
inputs.description: The callback invoked by invoke with a RuntimeRequest after the request passes the portable JSON check; it may return a response directly or a promise of one. A throw or rejection is converted to a runtime-failed response, while a blocking callback cannot be interrupted.

inputs.name: HandlerRuntimeAdapter.constructor.options
inputs.description: Constructor options for this adapter; only timeoutMs is read, and an absent value uses the 30,000 ms default. The deadline returns a runtime-timeout response for a late result, but it cannot interrupt synchronous work that blocks the calling thread.

inputs.name: HandlerRuntimeAdapter.invoke.request
inputs.description: One unit call, containing a required operation string and optional input value. invoke passes it to the handler only when its data is portable JSON: finite numbers, well-formed strings, plain objects or arrays, and no more than 64 levels deep; otherwise it resolves with an invalid-json response.

outputs.name: HandlerRuntimeAdapter.invoke
outputs.description: The normalized response envelope returned by invoke, either {ok:true,output:...} or {ok:false,error:{code,message}}. An invalid handler value becomes invalid-response; handler throws or rejections, nonportable requests, and deadline expiry resolve to runtime-failed, invalid-json, and runtime-timeout failures respectively.

outputs.name: HandlerRuntimeAdapter.close
outputs.description: The close promise resolves immediately with undefined; this adapter has no resources to release.

outputs.name: HandlerRuntimeAdapter.constructor
outputs.description: The constructor result is a HandlerRuntimeAdapter instance that holds the handler and resolved timeout for calls. Its kind is always module, and the instance is not a JSON value.
